historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Glaucus of Carystus was a celebrated athlete who competed in the Olympic and Isthmian games, demonstrating the excellence of the Ancient Greeks in the sport of boxing. He was also known for his association with the philosopher Demades of Argos, who would later become a prominent figure in the development of the Athenian democracy.
